DPopCleaner supply-chain pin
----------------------------
Archive: zapret-discord-youtube-1.10.2.zip
Exact size: 1508077 bytes
SHA-256: 5eaac9fb2e4b1abd693487452a3ff3f4dfe9578a45f9ddddfa4bc1f5a6bb62d5

The archive is downloaded only by the DPopCleaner Windows build/release pipeline, verified by exact byte length and SHA-256 before extraction, and then subjected only to the documented narrow Discord screen-sharing compatibility patch in strategy batch files. The DPopCleaner runtime does not download arbitrary Zapret binaries.
